== Published English Original Virtual Set 4 wording ==
The later slip drops the two-destiny cap and narrows the starship loss condition to the printed Independent type. It makes qualifying retrieval mandatory and limits the redraw function to battle with no literal once-per-turn wording. Its location condition gates the two battle functions instead of the original suspension. Both retain the named Imperial cards and Alter immunity.
